druid-balance.name: Balance Druid
druid-balance.note: Wowhead had no stand-alone Classic Balance pre-raid guide before Season of Mastery (its balance-druid-dps-pre-raid-best-in-slot-bis-gear-wow-classic page is first archived in December 2021), so this list is the 'Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear for Balance Druids - Phase 6' section of its Balance BiS gear guide (last modified 2021-05-15). The guide marks two items Best in the waist, ring and trinket rows; they keep the guide's order as ranks 1 and 2. It lists only three trinkets, two belts, two cloaks, two gloves, two legs and two boots, and no idol, so there is no relic row. Its one Weapon table lists the main-hand pair first, then the Rod of the Ogre Magi (Two-Hand), then Witchblade; each slot numbers its own items from 1, and the default takes the main hand and off-hand. The guide names both Arathi Basin exalted daggers, Sageclaw (League of Arathor, Alliance) and Mindfang (The Defilers, Horde), so they share rank 1 and no counterpart was added. It links no PvP rank items and no raid drops. Random-suffix items are listed by their base id, and the pool has only the base row's stats (no suffix). One whose base row has no spell stats is left out like a raid drop, and the entries below it move up: Eternal Crown (head), Eternal Spaulders (shoulder), Archivist Cape (back), Flameweave Cuffs (wrist), Slaghide Gauntlets (hands) and Adventurer's Belt (waist), all of Arcane Wrath in the guide. Abyssal Cloth Amice (of Sorcery) keeps its rank on its base row's spell hit, without the suffix. Diana's Pearl Necklace (22403) carries the client's name, Nacreous Shell Necklace. The Bloodvine set is crafted, but its Tailoring patterns need Zandalar Tribe reputation and its Bloodvine reagent comes from Zul'Gurub.

mage-fire.name: Fire Mage
mage-fire.note: Wowhead's Classic guide has no Fire list, so this is Icy Veins' Classic mage pre-raid list, which says it is for Fire mages heading into AQ40 (Phase 5; last updated 2020-12-06); its low-ranked Frost-only swaps fall outside the kept ranks. Its Horde PvP and Arathi Basin gear gets the Alliance counterpart at the same rank. Its Bloodvine set and Flarecore Leggings are crafted, not raid drops, but need Zul'Gurub / Molten Core materials. Its random-suffix items whose base item has no spell stats are left out, so the entries below them move up: Archivist Cape (back); Flameweave Cuffs, Tearfall Bracers, Master's Bracers and Abyssal Cloth Wristbands (wrist); Demon Blade (main hand). Abyssal Cloth Amice and Drakestone are random-suffix too but keep their rank on their base stats, without the guide's suffix. The guide's Diana's Pearl Necklace is 22403, named Nacreous Shell Necklace in the client, and it links Dryad's Wrist Bindings 19597 (the level-49 bracket version), so the level-60 version 19595 is listed instead.

mage-frost.name: Frost Mage
mage-frost.note: Wowhead's guide (Phase 6 heading, patch 1.13.7, last updated 2020-12-07) gives one mage list with no spec split; it is a Frost list: every random-suffix pick is 'of Frozen Wrath' and it ranks Frost-only items high (Boreal Mantle, Freezing Lich Robes, Tome of the Ice Lord, Wand of Biting Cold, Freezing Band). Its Horde PvP cloth gets the Alliance counterpart at the same rank. Its random-suffix items whose base item has no spell stats are left out, so the entries below them move up: Solstice Staff (its rank-1 staff), Eternal Spaulders, Archivist Cape and Master's Cloak, Tearfall Bracers (with Flameweave Cuffs and Master's Bracers below it), Master's Boots, Bloodstrike Dagger and Lunar Wand. So the back, main-hand and two-hand rows keep only the guide's two other items. Drakestone is random-suffix too but keeps its rank on its base +7 spell power, without the guide's suffix.

warlock-destruction.name: Destruction Warlock
warlock-destruction.note: The guide has one table ('Warlock Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear (BiS) - WoW Classic Phase 6') for every warlock. It does not split Affliction and Destruction. Its 15 'of Shadow Wrath' random-suffix items are left out, and the items below them move up. Their shadow damage comes only from the random suffix (RandomSelect), which the item pool doesn't model, so the base items have no spell stats. They are: Eternal Crown and Green Lens (head), Eternal Spaulders, Archivist Cape and Master's Cloak, Master's Vest, Tearfall Bracers, Flameweave Cuffs and Master's Bracers, Atal'ai Gloves, Master's Boots, Bloodstrike Dagger (one-hand), Drakestone (off-hand), Solstice Staff and Lunar Wand. That is why back and wrist keep fewer than three items. The Horde Dreadweave PvP pieces (Rank 7-10) get their Alliance counterpart at the same rank. The guide already lists both factions' battleground belts and Blackrock Depths rings.
